findings.title: Product finding: no worker offers code.review
findings.text:
Product finding: no worker offers code.review

An instance of Taktus met something the product lacks. A step needed a worker that offers `code.review`. No configured worker offers it. The step failed for it, and its run waited until the step could start again.

What would resolve it: the product offers `code.review` among its workers, through an adapter or an operation of one it has, or says why it does not.

Where it was met: run `run_example`, step `draft`, cause `no_worker`, as the blocked-time accounts of the instance record it (UC-6.12).

---

Raised by an instance of Taktus from its blocked-time accounts (UC-6.12, ADR-0046).

Occurrence 1: run `run_example`, step `draft`, cause `no_worker`, blocked since 2026-10-10T09:00:00Z, waited 600 s.
In all: 1 occurrence, 600 s waited over the 1 that ended.

findings.said: Product finding: no worker offers code.review: a product candidate; it may leave, at the level the operator set.
